Subject: Kickoff: MAP workshop + draft doc for Helio Analytics

Hi team,

Following our discovery last week, Helio asked for a tight evaluation plan and a workshop next week to align stakeholders. I've put together a first-pass MAP starter doc and a one-slide workshop outline to get the conversation moving. Links are below and I attached a PDF of the procurement questions Erica asked.

Quick goals for the MAP workshop (45-60m):
- Confirm success metrics and acceptance criteria (technical + business)
- Align stakeholders, owners, and timeline (week0 to week6)
- Validate a minimal pilot scope (3 personas + 1 integration)

What I need from you today:
- Jasmine: quick pass on technical acceptance criteria (token limits, latency targets, sandbox data)
- Jonas: add recommended milestones for infra & SRE sign-off (week numbers)
- Ben: pricing/packaging note for a 30-day pilot + suggested scope for Dedicated vs Hosted options

Links / stubs:
- GDoc: Helio MAP starter (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB-helio-MAP-draft
- GSlides: Workshop starter: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1cD-helio-workshop-slides

Attachments: procurement-questions.pdf (attached to this thread)

Erica — if the timeline below looks reasonable we'd propose a 45-minute workshop on Tue 10/26 or Wed 10/27. If procurement needs more time we can push to the following week.

Thanks — I kept the MAP intentionally compact so we can iterate quickly during the workshop.

—Marissa

Marissa — thanks for seeding this. I made a handful of inline edits in the GDoc (section: Technical acceptance). High-level notes here so we have them in thread: 

- Sandbox data: Helio will provide a 3-day sample (anonymized) and a schema. We should include exact upload expectations in the doc.
- Latency target: 95th percentile < 350ms for non-streamed endpoints; streamed SSE for chat flows (30s horizon).
- Token limits: recommend capping at 1,024 per call for the pilot to avoid cache fragmentation.

I've also added a short checklist for security/compliance checkpoints (SOC2 evidence, audit-log retention, KMS access patterns). Not exhaustive — just enough to surface during the workshop.

I'll be on the call Tues/Wed either day; prefer Wed for extra prep time.

Jasmine
